item.title: contact us
item.description: The workshop is currently co-led by Vili Virkki (vilivirkki@uef.fi) and Xander Huggins (xander.huggins@glasgow.ac.uk) – please reach out to us for any queries relating to workshop activities, interest in joining future workshops, or anything else!

item.title: recent papers and preprints
item.description:
Here are some recent papers and preprints by workshop members realted to the workshop’s theme of freshwater resilience. Workshop members are shown in bold.

Group perspective: Orientations to navigate the complexity of freshwater resilience in social-ecological systems. EarthArXiv (preprint).

papers

  • Dahlmann, H., Andersen, L. S., Schaphoff, S., et al. (2026). Shifting water scarcities: irrigation alleviates agricultural green water deficits while increasing blue water scarcity. Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 30, 3185–3201.
  • Kaandorp, C., Wang-Erlandsson, L., Hattle, A., et al. (2026). Opportunities to foreground human embeddedness in the Anthropocene biosphere. Cell Reports Sustainability.
  • Virkki, V., Andersen, L. S., te Wierik, S., Gerten, D., Porkka, M. (2026). Regionally divergent drivers behind transgressions of the freshwater change planetary boundary. Nature Communications, 17, 5132.
  • Wang-Erlandsson, L., Moore, M.-L., Gordon, L., Folke, C., Falkenmark, M. (2025). Fostering water resilience in the Anthropocene. Global Sustainability, 8, e46.

preprints

  • Fahrländer, S., Lotcheris, R., Andersen, L. S., et al. (2026). Coupled atmospheric moisture and trade networks reveal a concentration of global freshwater risk in a handful of countries. Research Square.
  • Gerten, D., Almeida, B., Lade, S. J., Norberg, A. (2025). Join the dots on planetary boundary interactions. EGUsphere.
  • Kunadi, A., Kallio, M., Seppä, I., et al. (2026). When a year starts shapes global hydrological conclusions. Research Square.
  • Lotcheris, R. A., Knecht, N., Wang-Erlandsson, L., Rocha, J. C. (2026). Global assessment of terrestrial water cycle resilience. EarthArXiv.
